raw_text: Chinese Coast Guard vessels fired water cannons at Philippine boats attempting to deliver supplies to the grounded warship BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal, the Philippine military said Tuesday. The incident marks a dangerous escalation in the disputed waterway. Manila condemned the action as a violation of international law. The Western Command reported that supply boats sustained structural damage.
